selected_findings.title: Assert active selection and accessible action announcements
selected_findings.why_it_matters: The keyboard acceptance test would still pass if every card permanently exposed aria-pressed=false and the matching live region never announced an action. A screen-reader user would then lose confirmation of which card is selected, whether Escape cancelled it, and whether a match or reorder succeeded. The plan explicitly requires selected/target states and focus/status verification; extend this existing interaction test so those regressions fail.
